title: Canonical tensor section map for a ring-sheaf pushout
statement: Let f:U → X be a morphism of schemes. Put A=f_*O_U, ρ:O_X → A its structure map, IA=f⁻¹A, r₀:f⁻¹O_X → O_U its adjoint structure map, and t₀=f⁻¹ρ. Let B be a commutative-ring sheaf on U, b:O_U → B and t:IA → B making a pushout of r₀ and t₀. For an open V of X put W=f⁻¹V, D=Γ(X,V), C=Γ(U,W), and δ=t_W ∘ η_{A,V}:C → B(W). Construct q:C tensor_D C → B(W) by CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct.desc, using the section commutativity proved in [stage3-affine-pushout-ring-section-comm].

source.place: Tag 01SB affine reduction; Tags 01I9, 01IA and 01HV for affine pullback sections

proof.text: Apply the explicit ring tensor pushout desc to the maps b_W and δ and their proved commutativity equation. This determines q uniquely; its data is constructed using proved prerequisites only.
